family: The single total OR family defined in proof.md: f_0=0 on the empty input; for n>=1, f_n(x)=1 iff at least one input bit x_i is 1. One fixed polynomial-time evaluator scans the input once. The same family is used at every length.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)=n-1 for every n>=2, hence C_B2(f_n)>=(1)*n-o(n); in particular liminf C_B2(f_n)/n>=1 at every sufficiently large integer length n=|x| in the full Li-Yang B2 model.
